"""Cross-eval LF hold-one-out models on the correctly-indexed 3-LF conf>=2 test set."""
import json
import sys
import time
import torch
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from sklearn.metrics import f1_score, accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score, classification_report

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
from probe_model import ProgressProbe, WindowDataset, collate_fn

ROOT = Path(__file__).parent

MODELS = {
    "baseline_probe_001": ROOT / "checkpoints" / "best_model.pt",
    "no_cmd_rep": ROOT / "checkpoints_holdout_no_cmd_rep" / "best_model.pt",
    "no_file_diff": ROOT / "checkpoints_holdout_no_file_diff" / "best_model.pt",
    "no_ob": ROOT / "checkpoints_holdout_no_ob" / "best_model.pt",
}

def load_model(ckpt_path, device="cpu"):
    ck = torch.load(ckpt_path, map_location=device, weights_only=False)
    model = ProgressProbe(
        embed_dim=ck["embed_dim"],
        hidden_size=ck["hidden_size"],
        num_layers=ck["num_layers"],
        dropout=ck.get("dropout", 0.1),
    )
    model.load_state_dict(ck["model_state_dict"])
    model.eval()
    return model

def evaluate(model, dataset, device="cpu"):
    from torch.utils.data import DataLoader
    loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=256, shuffle=False, collate_fn=collate_fn)
    all_preds, all_labels = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for padded, labels, lengths in loader:
            logits = model(padded.to(device), lengths.to(device))
            preds = (torch.sigmoid(logits) >= 0.5).long().cpu().numpy()
            all_preds.extend(preds)
            all_labels.extend(labels.long().numpy())
    all_preds = np.array(all_preds)
    all_labels = np.array(all_labels)
    macro_f1 = f1_score(all_labels, all_preds, average="macro")
    acc = accuracy_score(all_labels, all_preds)
    prec = precision_score(all_labels, all_preds, average="macro")
    rec = recall_score(all_labels, all_preds, average="macro")
    f1_stag = f1_score(all_labels, all_preds, pos_label=0)
    f1_prog = f1_score(all_labels, all_preds, pos_label=1)
    report = classification_report(all_labels, all_preds, target_names=["stagnation", "progress"], output_dict=True)
    return {
        "macro_f1": round(macro_f1, 4),
        "accuracy": round(acc, 4),
        "precision_macro": round(prec, 4),
        "recall_macro": round(rec, 4),
        "f1_stagnation": round(f1_stag, 4),
        "f1_progress": round(f1_prog, 4),
        "classification_report": report,
    }

def main():
    t0 = time.time()
    print("Loading data...", flush=True)
    data = torch.load(ROOT / "data" / "embeddings.pt", map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
    embeddings = data["embeddings"]
    labels = data["labels"]
    confidences = data["confidences"]
    print(f"Data loaded in {time.time()-t0:.1f}s — {len(embeddings)} total windows", flush=True)

    # Build conf>=2 index mapping: position in filtered array -> position in full array
    keep_indices = [i for i, c in enumerate(confidences) if c >= 2]

    # split_info test_indices are positions within the conf>=2 filtered array

    test_indices_in_filtered = split_info["test_indices"]

    # Map to full array indices
    test_indices_in_full = [keep_indices[i] for i in test_indices_in_filtered]
    print(f"Test set: {len(test_indices_in_full)} windows (mapped from filtered indices)", flush=True)

    # Sanity check: all mapped indices should have conf>=2
    for idx in test_indices_in_full:
        assert confidences[idx] >= 2, f"Index {idx} has conf={confidences[idx]}"

    test_embs = [embeddings[i] for i in test_indices_in_full]
    test_labels = [labels[i] for i in test_indices_in_full]
    test_ds = WindowDataset(test_embs, test_labels)

    del data, embeddings, labels, confidences
    import gc; gc.collect()

    n_stag = sum(1 for l in test_labels if l == 0)
    n_prog = sum(1 for l in test_labels if l == 1)
    print(f"Label distribution: stagnation={n_stag}, progress={n_prog}", flush=True)

    # Compare with buggy version
    buggy_embs_data = torch.load(ROOT / "data" / "embeddings.pt", map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
    buggy_labels = [buggy_embs_data["labels"][i] for i in test_indices_in_filtered]
    mismatch = sum(1 for a, b in zip(test_labels, buggy_labels) if int(a) != int(b))
    print(f"\nLabel mismatch vs buggy indexing: {mismatch}/{len(test_labels)} ({mismatch/len(test_labels)*100:.1f}%)", flush=True)
    del buggy_embs_data, buggy_labels; gc.collect()

    results = {}
    for name, ckpt_path in MODELS.items():
        t1 = time.time()
        print(f"\nEvaluating {name} ...", flush=True)
        model = load_model(ckpt_path)
        metrics = evaluate(model, test_ds)
        results[name] = metrics
        print(f"  macro_f1={metrics['macro_f1']}, acc={metrics['accuracy']}, "
              f"f1_stag={metrics['f1_stagnation']}, f1_prog={metrics['f1_progress']} "
              f"({time.time()-t1:.1f}s)", flush=True)
        del model

    # Load buggy results for comparison
    buggy_results = {}
    buggy_path = ROOT / "lf_holdout_crosseval_results.json"
    if buggy_path.exists():
        buggy_data = json.load(open(buggy_path))
        buggy_results = buggy_data.get("results", {})

    output = {
        "description": "LF hold-one-out cross-eval on CORRECTLY-INDEXED 3-LF conf>=2 test set",
        "fix_applied": "Mapped split_info test_indices (filtered-array positions) through keep_indices to full-array positions",
        "test_set_size": len(test_indices_in_full),
        "label_distribution": {"stagnation": n_stag, "progress": n_prog},
        "results": results,
    }

    print(f"\nSaved to {out_path}", flush=True)

    # Print comparison table

if __name__ == "__main__":
